claims: The first build-6 CI attempt started from the frozen source but was deliberately interrupted after Xcode automatically rewrote three shared Watch scheme files during project opening.
The attempt is not a full-CI acceptance pass. The actual rewrite diff and interruption record are preserved.
Only the automatically rewritten schemes were restored after closing Xcode; generated-project parity passed before a new independent CI attempt began.
limitations: No product-source, icon, privacy or version changes were introduced by the interrupted attempt.
The signed archive completed before Xcode opened the project and is independently inspected separately.

authorityReference.reference: September 6 owner request to replace the icon, rebuild, and perform physical checks.
